text: Plant protection is an interdisciplinary subject centered on the interaction between plants, pests and the environment. It aims to study the occurrence patterns of diseases, pests, weeds, rodents and other hazards suffered by crops, trees, horticultural plants, etc., and to develop prevention and control technologies. Its goal is to ensure the healthy growth of plants through scientific means, reduce agricultural losses and maintain ecological balance. The major integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as botany, microbiology, entomology, ecology and agricultural science, aiming to cultivate compound talents with the ability to diagnose pests and diseases, develop green control technologies and manage agricultural ecology.
